annotation.authors_or_issuer: La Moncloa (Government of Spain), Council of Ministers
key_provisions_or_claims: Council of Ministers approved draft Organic Law for the proper use and governance of AI, sent to Parliament.
Law adapts the EU AI Act's risk-based classification and sets a sanctions system.
Mandatory human supervision of AI models and provider responsibility.
AESIA (A Coruña) is the central oversight authority, alongside sectoral authorities such as Banco de España, AEPD and CGPJ.
Governs sandboxes and promotes AI delegates and higher transparency in public administration.
annotation.summary_en: Government press report on the 26 May 2026 Council of Ministers meeting, which approved a draft Spanish Organic Law on AI governance implementing the EU AI Act: risk-based classification, sanctions, mandatory human supervision, AESIA and sectoral authorities, sandboxes and public-sector AI delegates. Also covers unrelated items such as pensions and television licensing.
annotation.title_clean: The Government of Spain regulates artificial intelligence to ensure its reliable, ethical and guaranteed use
annotation.title_en: The Government of Spain regulates artificial intelligence to ensure its reliable, ethical and guaranteed use
